Some approaches aim to reduce the inference cost for all inputs equally (e.g. Hinton et al., 2015; Jaszczur et al., 2021; Hubara et al., 2016; So et al., 2021; Shazeer, 2019). occurrences.excerpt: We analyze our method in a variety of tasks and model sizes: unconditional generation from a 97M parameter GPTlike model trained on lm1b, English to German translation and news article summarization with an 11B parameters T5-XXL model, and a dialog task with a 137B parameter LaMDA model. We implement our method and compare actual walltimes for T5-XXL to those of the robust T5X implementation (Roberts et al., 2022), showing an out-ofthe-box latency improvement of 2X-3X, without any change to the outputs (Section 4).
